d.תשלום עבור שעות העבודה הרגילות שעבדתם בח: Payment for the regular hours you worked in the month, at an hourly rate.
d.מחושב כמספר השעות כפול התעריף לשעה. בדקו: Calculated as the number of hours times the hourly rate. Check that the number of hours matches what you actually worked.
d.תשלום עבור השעתיים הראשונות מעבר לשעות ה: Payment for the first two hours beyond the regular daily working hours, at a 25% premium.
d.לפי חוק שעות עבודה ומנוחה, שעות נוספות מ: Under the Hours of Work and Rest Law, overtime is paid at a higher rate: 125% for the first two hours and 150% from the third hour onward.
d.תשלום עבור שעות נוספות מהשעה השלישית ואי: Payment for overtime from the third hour onward (and usually also work on Shabbat or holidays), at a 50% premium.
d.תעריף מוגדל שנקבע בחוק. עבודה בשבת/חג מש: A higher rate set by law. Work on Shabbat or holidays is usually paid at least 150% (and sometimes 175% / 200% depending on the agreement).
d.תשלום עבור שעות שעבדתם מעבר להיקף המשרה: Payment for hours you worked beyond your regular full-time scope.
d.שעות נוספות מזכות בתוספת שכר לפי חוק. אם: Overtime entitles you to extra pay by law. If overtime is paid as a global amount, check that your agreement states this explicitly.
d.החזר על הוצאות הנסיעה שלכם מהבית לעבודה: Reimbursement for your travel costs between home and work.
d.המעסיק חייב להשתתף בהוצאות נסיעה בתחבורה: The employer must contribute to public transport costs up to a daily ceiling set in the extension order (in recent years about ₪22.6 per day). This amount is tax-exempt up to a certain ceiling.
d.תשלום שנתי שמגיע לעובדים כחלק מזכויות הע: An annual payment due to employees as part of their rights, usually paid once a year or in parts.
d.מספר ימי ההבראה תלוי בוותק (5 ימים בשנה: The number of recuperation days depends on seniority (5 days in the first year, up to 10 days with long seniority) and is multiplied by the daily rate set in the extension order.
d.תשלום עבור ימי חופשה שלא נוצלו, שהמעסיק: Payment for unused vacation days that the employer pays you in cash.
d.בדרך כלל משולם בסיום העסקה. במהלך העסקה: Usually paid when employment ends. During ongoing employment, vacation redemption is limited by law.
d.תשלום עבור ימים שבהם נעדרתם עקב מחלה, בה: Payment for days you were absent due to illness, with a medical certificate.
d.לפי חוק דמי מחלה: היום הראשון ללא תשלום,: Under the Sick Pay Law: the first day is unpaid, the second and third days 50%, and from the fourth day 100%.
d.תשלום נוסף על השכר הקבוע, בדרך כלל על הי: An additional payment on top of the fixed salary, usually for achievements, sales or a special event.
d.בונוסים ופרמיות חייבים במס כמו שכר רגיל,: Bonuses are taxed like regular pay, so in the month you receive one the deductions look higher.
d.שווי כספי של הטבות שקיבלתם מהמעסיק (למשל: The monetary value of benefits you received from your employer (for example a car, meals or a phone). This is not cash you receive.
d.מס הכנסה רואה בהטבות אלו הכנסה לכל דבר,: The Tax Authority treats these benefits as income, so they are added to taxable pay and affect the size of the deductions.
d.סכום קבוע שמשולם בכל חודש עבור שעות נוספ: A fixed amount paid every month for overtime or other supplements, without an exact count of hours.
d.נפוץ בהסכמי עבודה \"גלובליים\". חשוב לוו: Common in "global" employment agreements. It is important to verify that the agreement defines how many overtime hours the amount covers.
d.תוספת שכר שמוענקת בגין שנות עבודה אצל המ: A pay supplement granted for years of work with the employer or in the sector.
d.קבועה בדרך כלל בהסכם קיבוצי או בחוזה האי: Usually set in a collective agreement or personal contract, and it grows over the years.
d.תוספת שכר בגין השכלה, תפקיד או אחריות מי: A pay supplement for education, role or special responsibility.
d.נקבעת בחוזה או בהסכם. מקובל שמצוינת כמרכ: Set in the contract or agreement. It is customary to list it as a separate component of pay.
d.מס שמנוכה ישירות מהשכר ומועבר לרשות המסי: Tax deducted directly from your pay and transferred to the Tax Authority on your behalf ("withholding at source").
d.המס מחושב לפי מדרגות מס עולות: ככל שהשכר: Tax is calculated by rising tax brackets: the higher the monthly pay, the larger the part of it taxed at a higher rate. Your tax credit points reduce the tax.
d.הפרשה למוסד לביטוח לאומי, שמממן קצבאות,: A contribution to the National Insurance Institute, which funds allowances, maternity pay, unemployment benefits, disability benefits and old-age pensions.
d.עד כ-60% מהשכר הממוצע במשק משולם שיעור מ: Up to about 60% of the average wage a reduced rate is paid, and above that a higher rate up to a ceiling. The deduction gives you entitlement to social insurance.
d.תשלום חובה שמממן את סל הבריאות הציבורי ו: A mandatory payment that funds the public health basket and the health funds.
d.כל תושב משלם מס בריאות, והוא מנוכה בנפרד: Every resident pays health tax, and it is deducted separately or together with National Insurance. It too is at a reduced rate up to a certain amount and a higher rate above it.
d.חלק מהשכר שמופרש מדי חודש לחיסכון הפנסיו: The part of your pay set aside each month for your pension savings, in a pension fund or managers' insurance.
d.לפי החוק, חובה להפריש לפנסיה לפחות 6% מש: By law you must contribute at least 6% of your pay (your share) and the employer 6.5%, plus 6% for severance. This is your money, accumulated for retirement age.
d.חיסכון לטווח בינוני שאתם ומעסיקכם מפרישי: Medium-term savings that you and your employer contribute to, usually 2.5% from the employee and 7.5% from the employer.
d.כספי הקרן פטורים ממס רווחי הון אם נפדים: Fund money is exempt from capital gains tax if withdrawn after 6 years (or 3 for professional use). It is an excellent savings product, but not mandatory in every workplace.
d.תשלום לארגון העובדים או לוועד העובדים במ: A payment to the workers' organization or the workers' committee at the workplace.
d.בעבודה שבה חל הסכם קיבוצי ניכוי כזה נפוץ: Where a collective agreement applies, such a deduction is common. It provides representation and rights under the collective agreement, and you can ask to stop it according to the rules.
d.ניכוי עבור כסף שקיבלתם מראש מהמעסיק, או: A deduction for money you received in advance from the employer, or a loan the employer gave that you repay in instalments.

d.כל ניכוי אישי דורש הסכמה שלכם. אם אינכם: Every personal deduction requires your consent. If you don't recognise a deduction, it is worth asking the payroll department.
d.הכסף שהמעסיק מפריש לפנסיה שלכם בנוסף לשכ: Money the employer sets aside for your pension on top of your pay, which is not taken from your pay.

d.ביטוח לאומי מה זה? הפרשה למוסד לביטוח לא: National Insurance: what is it? A contribution to the National Insurance Institute, which funds allowances, maternity pay, unemployment benefits, disability benefits and old-age pensions. Why is it in your payslip? Up to about 60% of the average wage a reduced rate is paid, and above that a higher rate up to a ceiling. The deduction gives you entitlement to social insurance.
